-- Physics/instrumentation questions misclassified as Small Parts
UPDATE quickfireQuestions 
SET category = 'Physics'
WHERE id IN (206,207,208,209,210,211,212,213,214,215,216,217,218,219,220,221,222,223,300);

-- MSK questions misclassified as Small Parts
UPDATE quickfireQuestions 
SET category = 'MSK'
WHERE id IN (572,573,574,575,576);

-- Verify counts
SELECT category, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM quickfireQuestions 
WHERE category IN ('Small Parts','Physics','MSK')
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;
